title: Bike / E-bike tour : Plateau, Mile-End, Jean-Talon Market by Fitz
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This tour is for participants 14 years and older.
policies: Operates in all weather conditions.In case of rain, we will provide some stylish rain capes.
Casual, comfortable weather appropriate clothes are recommend, flip flops are not.
Tours can be bilingual upon request (French & English).
Avoid coming by car, parking is extremely difficult near our shop
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our guided small-group rides are a fun, safe activity and a great way to get out, explore, and connect.

This authentic tour goes beyond downtown into Montreal's hip, must-see 'hoods, giving you a behind-the-scenes feel for the city's relaxed way of life. We'll set you up on a quality bike that's a genuine pleasure to ride, then lead you on a loop route along uncrowded bike paths, quiet streets, and charming green laneways.

This is our staff-favourite tour. You'll cruise through the artsy Plateau and Mile-End, take in views of Mont-Royal from Outremont, then roll on to the charming neighbourhoods of Little Italy and Petite-Patrie. Your guide is one of our specially trained Montreal ambassadors, there to share the stories of Montrealers and their culture, from musical heroes to culinary icons to the open-minded residents and students who fill these streets today. Even if you've lived here for years, you'll discover something new.
